nom: Neutrogena Beach Defense Sunscreen Spray SPF 30

avis.texte: This has been my go-to sunscreen for years! Love the smell, it doesn't feel tacky and most importantly has great sun protection! I live in a tropical state and this has been a great purchase.

This is my family’s favorite spray sunscreen. Two of my kids and myself have sensitive skin and we have had zero issues with this sunscreen. The coverage and protection is phenomenal. With everything you get from this sunscreen, the price is fantastic. It has a fresh and pleasant smell as well - but doesn’t irritate the skin. We have been using it for over a year now for trip trips to the beach and most recently a cruise. Another thing I love about this sunscreen is that it does not feel sticky and absorbs well.

avis.titre: I wouldn't say this sunscreen has magic powers, but...I also wouldn't deny it.
avis.texte: My 6yo daughter loves being able to apply her own sunscreen. This bottle works for two main reasons - first, it's cheap enough that I don't mind letting her spray a bit too much, and second, somehow it protects her and she hasn't gotten a sunburn. I'm going to say it one more time for those who missed it: she's SIX YEARS OLD. She applies this herself. And she does not get burned. Look I'm gonna be honest. When it's time for sunscreen, I can be found focusing on my 8yo, who has a sunscreen allergy and needs to apply mineral sunscreen, and it takes forever. I don't have the patience to tolerate my 6yo's impatience at having to wait to put on her sunscreen until I'm ready, so...I started letting her do it herself. And once she'd done it a few times, I stopped closely monitoring how the sunscreen goes on. Yet...no incidents have suggested she's not getting complete coverage. How is this possible? This is the same girl who puts empty bowls back into the fridge without realizing she's doing it. But it works, and IYKYK - when you find something that works, you stick with it!

avis.titre: My go to sunscreen for all my vacations
avis.texte: This is my go to sunscreen. I like the scent I like that it's not oily. It seems to last a long time even after going in the water. I also liked the price as I happened to catch it on sale. I have gone through several cans and have never had a problem with them not spraying like they sprayed the first time I started using the can.
Nice even spray, with light feel after it dries. Protects even my redheaded easily sunburnt skin!

avis.titre: Re-Purchase because it stays on and easy to apply!
avis.texte: Very tall can and Great spf that stays on well. Spray prevents getting all over your hands and is easier to apply to harder to reach spots, such as the back. Being protected from the sun while doing yard work is important and spf 30/water resistant for over an hour, the perfect match for our family. Re-applying is so convenient, just spray on!! Package has clear shrink wrap for shipping purpose. We have bought this spf prior and this is a re-purchase!
Great protect, great protection, for a water baby who lives outside during the summer. No white residue and easy application.
